use_cases: Product showcase cards with vibrant aurora effects
Feature highlight cards with customizable gradient themes
Premium profile or user cards with glowing borders
Interactive theme-switching cards for design systems
Visual-heavy card components for media and entertainment apps
ai_summary: An AuroraCard component featuring customizable gradient border themes that create glowing aurora-like effects against dark backgrounds. Supports multiple color schemes including original, sunset, ocean, forest, galaxy, coral, mint, and yellow themes. Ideal for creating visually striking product cards, feature highlights, or premium UI elements in SaaS, media, and e-commerce platforms. Includes theme switching capability via React state management.
